description_en: Updates the logon switch, member synchronization switch, or application configuration of a specified external identity provider for a workspace. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The update is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status and track the progress
description_zh: 更新指定工作空间外部身份提供商的登录开关、成员同步开关或应用配置。未指定的属性保持不变。更新为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-123456 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
parameters.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow workspace users to log on through the external identity provider
fields.help_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The App ID of the Feishu application. This parameter is required when the binding type is Feishu
fields.help_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: Required. The secret of the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query APIs
fields.help_zh: 必填。外部身份提供商应用的密钥。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk enterprise. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: The data encryption key for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query APIs
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的数据加密密钥，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: The verification token for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query APIs
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的校验令牌，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: The new application configuration of the external identity provider. If not specified, the existing configuration remains unchanged
fields.help_zh: 新的外部身份提供商应用配置，不指定时保持不变
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: Currently, only SAML is supported. This parameter may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. OIDC placeholder initialization is not supported
fields.help_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. This parameter is required for manual entry. Queries return the short name
fields.help_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称
fields.name: binding_type

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and up to 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations do not support replacement. It is different from the local entity ID returned by SP queries
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en: Can be set independently. If omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If omitted for the first time, the default value is false. A valid SAML configuration is required
fields.help_zh: 可独立设置；更新省略时保留已有值，首次省略默认 false；要求已有有效 SAML 配置
fields.name: jit_provision_enabled

fields.help_en: Can be set independently. If omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If omitted for the first time, the default value is false. A valid SAML configuration is required
fields.help_zh: 可独立设置；更新省略时保留已有值，首次省略默认 false；要求已有有效 SAML 配置
fields.name: jit_update_enabled

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段
fields.name: login_url

fields.help_en: The input is the XML text of a single IdP EntityDescriptor, with a maximum size of 1 MiB. It cannot be a URL or a file path. It is mutually exclusive with the four manual entry fields
fields.help_zh: 输入为单个 IdP EntityDescriptor 的 XML 文本，最大 1 MiB，不是 URL 或文件路径；与四个手填字段互斥
fields.name: metadata_xml

fields.help_en: Required for manual entry. It must be a non-empty array using PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is validated, and up to 10 certificates are supported
fields.help_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，最多十张
fields.name: x509_certificates

fields.help_en: The input supports either XML or complete manual entry. Queries return standardized configurations and do not echo the original XML. This parameter can be omitted if it is not configured
fields.help_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略
fields.name: saml

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. After it is enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
fields.help_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户
fields.name: sync_enabled

fields.help_en: When the mode is SelectedDepartments, it must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this parameter
fields.help_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略
fields.name: department_ids

fields.help_en:
Valid values:
AllAuthorized: The full authorization scope, subject to the application address book authorization limits.
SelectedDepartments: The selected departments and all their sub-departments.
When explicitly submitting syncScope, you must provide a valid mode, which is validated by the backend
fields.help_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Follows the synchronization scope definition by department. If omitted during creation, the default value is AllAuthorized. The first vendor synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically perform full synchronization
fields.help_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步
fields.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: The request content for updating the external identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 更新外部身份提供商的请求内容
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The updated external identity provider binding information
data.description_zh: 更新后的外部身份提供商绑定信息

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only by GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual received status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. This parameter is required for manual entry. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and up to 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations do not support replacement. It is different from the local entity ID returned by SP queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

jitProvisionStatus.description_en: The actual switch value. Valid values: Enabled and Disabled
jitProvisionStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled

jitUpdateStatus.description_en: The actual switch value. Valid values: Enabled and Disabled
jitUpdateStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled

loginUrl.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual switch value. Valid values: Enabled and Disabled. This value is not equivalent to the expected loginEnabled value saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

loginEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to allow workspace users to log on through the external identity provider
loginEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录

protocol.description_en: Currently, only SAML is supported. This parameter may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. OIDC placeholder initialization is not supported
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The input supports either XML or complete manual entry. Queries return standardized configurations and do not echo the original XML. This parameter can be omitted if it is not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. This parameter is required for manual entry. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be non-empty and up to 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations do not support replacement. It is different from the local entity ID returned by SP queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

jitProvisionEnabled.description_en: Can be set independently. If omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If omitted for the first time, the default value is false. A valid SAML configuration is required
jitProvisionEnabled.description_zh: 可独立设置；更新省略时保留已有值，首次省略默认 false；要求已有有效 SAML 配置

jitUpdateEnabled.description_en: Can be set independently. If omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If omitted for the first time, the default value is false. A valid SAML configuration is required
jitUpdateEnabled.description_zh: 可独立设置；更新省略时保留已有值，首次省略默认 false；要求已有有效 SAML 配置

loginUrl.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: Required for manual entry. It must be a non-empty array using PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is validated, and up to 10 certificates are supported
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，最多十张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example shows a public test certificate for idp.example.com. For actual integration, you must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

status.description_en: The binding status. Valid values: CONFIGURED (the configuration is accepted and waiting for the user pool to be activated), SYNCING (synchronizing organization members), SYNCED (organization member synchronization is completed), READY (the binding is in effect), SYNC_FAILED (organization member synchronization failed), UPDATING (updating the configuration), UPDATE_FAILED (configuration update failed), DISCONNECTING (disconnecting), and DISCONNECT_FAILED (disconnection failed)
status.description_zh: 绑定状态。可选值：CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. After it is enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
syncEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户

syncScope.description_en: Follows the synchronization scope definition by department. If omitted during creation, the default value is AllAuthorized. The first vendor synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically perform full synchronization
syncScope.description_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步

departmentIds.description_en: When the mode is SelectedDepartments, it must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this parameter
departmentIds.description_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en:
Valid values:
AllAuthorized: The full authorization scope, subject to the application address book authorization limits.
SelectedDepartments: The selected departments and all their sub-departments.
When explicitly submitting syncScope, you must provide a valid mode, which is validated by the backend
mode.description_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验

syncScope.title_en: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段
syncScope.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned when the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
